user.title: KNX Media Player
user.description: Choose the media player to control via KNX (e.g. Sonos or Music Assistant). You set the group addresses afterwards in the options.

abort.already_configured: This media player is already set up.

init.title: KNX Media Player
init.description: All settings on one page. Empty group addresses are not used.

data_description.max_volume: Highest volume that can be set via KNX.
data_description.volume_step: Step for “volume up/down” and relative dimming.
data_description.stop_instead_of_pause: “Pause” stops playback instead (e.g. for radio streams).

playback.name: Playback
playback.description: Group addresses for control. Empty fields are not used.

data_description.addr_toggle: 1 = toggle between play and pause. 0 is ignored.

start.name: Playback start
start.description: Applies when a play command starts a player that is not playing, so an old loud volume is never resumed. Empty = no change. Pausing and already running playback are not affected.

data_description.start_volume: Set before starting, capped by the volume limit.
data_description.start_source: Plays this source (e.g. a Sonos favorite) instead of just resuming.

data_description.addr_volume_step: 1 = one step louder, 0 = one step quieter.
data_description.addr_volume_dim: One step per telegram, step code 0 = stop.

status_play.name: Feedback: playback
status_play.description: Group addresses that receive whether the player is playing or paused (also as answer to read telegrams).

status_level.name: Feedback: volume
status_level.description: Group addresses for volume and mute.

status_text.name: Feedback: text
status_text.description: Text addresses (DPT 16.001, 14 characters) for the current playback, e.g. for a display.

data_description.idle_text: Sent while the player is not playing. Empty = empty text.

scenes.name: Scenes
scenes.description: Scenes 1 to 5 are in the following sections.

data_description.addr_scene: Scene number 1 to 5 starts the scene with that number.

scene_1.name: Scene 1
scene_1.description: Runs on scene number 1 or via its own 1-bit address (1 = start, 0 = pause).

data_description.scene_1_source: Pick from the player's sources or type the name.

scene_2.name: Scene 2
scene_2.description: Runs on scene number 2 or via its own 1-bit address (1 = start, 0 = pause).

data_description.scene_2_source: Pick from the player's sources or type the name.

scene_3.name: Scene 3
scene_3.description: Runs on scene number 3 or via its own 1-bit address (1 = start, 0 = pause).

data_description.scene_3_source: Pick from the player's sources or type the name.

scene_4.name: Scene 4
scene_4.description: Runs on scene number 4 or via its own 1-bit address (1 = start, 0 = pause).

data_description.scene_4_source: Pick from the player's sources or type the name.

scene_5.name: Scene 5
scene_5.description: Runs on scene number 5 or via its own 1-bit address (1 = start, 0 = pause).

data_description.scene_5_source: Pick from the player's sources or type the name.

error.invalid_address: At least one group address is invalid (expected e.g. 1/2/3).
error.scene_no_trigger: A scene with a source or volume needs the scene address or its own 1-bit address.
